notes: Tail case: all units re-examined. U1 door disambiguated (narrow white door right of the dark grey shutter); U2 masked object is a tall white wooden shutter panel left of the arched double door (not a door) and the replace was colour-only -> trellis with climbing roses; U3 is the large ANTIQUITES sign; U4 drain grate disambiguated and payload made specific. All masks are the whole edited objects; no v2 masks needed.
